checkAutoEarlyStop.description:
Criteria to early stop hpo search and retrieve a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase} based on a targetScore if
set to true.

targetScore.description:
targetScore to early stop hpo search in {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}. The validation score in {@link Hpo.Trial}
needs to be greater than or equal to targetScore for early stop to be invoked in {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.
However, one might encounter scenarios where floating point arithmetic might render equality check to be imprecise
and early stop is not invoked. In such scenarios, it is recommended to lower the target score by a few decimal points.
Ignored if {@link Hpo.EarlyTermination#checkAutoEarlyStop} is set to False.

maxSearchTime.description: Maximum time to run the search, in minutes (total time including any nested searches).

maxTrials.description: Upper bound on total hyperparameter sets that we are evaluating during the search.

maxConcurrentTrials.description: Upper bound on total hyperparameter sets that we are evaluating in parallel during the search.

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: If value is greater than 0, failed trials of hpo experiment will be attempted for recovery.

keepAllTrainedPipes.description:
If true, then all {@link MlPipe}s will remain persisted after auto-tuning.
By default, this is false, and only the best pipe is guaranteed to be stored.

experimentName.description:
The experiment name for a hyperparameter optimization search on an {@link MlPipeline}. A new experiment name needs
to be specified for every hyperparameter optimization search initiated.

validationTechnique.description:
Interface to generate training and validation subsets from data, and scoring metrics for scoring a model on the
validation data set. {@link MlSplit.Technique} is used for creating the validation split to be used for
hyperparameter optimization. Some of the possible techniques include {@link MlSplit.Holdout}, {@link MlSplit.KFold}
and {@link MlSplit.Custom}.

algorithm.description:
Interface to generate sets of hyperparameters from the hyperparameter
search space.

hpoMetric.description:
The name of the output of {@link #MlPipeline#score} to use to determine the best trained pipeline. This value must
exist in {@link MlPipeline#scoreNames}.

experimentOverride.description:
By default, HPO will be conducted using {@link Hpo.Experiment} as the executor. However, an
override can be specified here to use a different executor. The override should be specified as
a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase} sub-type that the user wishes to use.
For example, `MyHpo.Experiment`, assuming `MyHpo.Experiment mixes Hpo.ExperimentBase`.

title:
{@link Hpo.Spec} allows for user configuration of {@link MlPipe#search}. Some configurations include how to validate
results, which search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

Note : If you are planning to have a large-scale hyperparameter optimization job that can exceed 30 min to execute,
remember to adjust {@link Hpo.ExecutionConstraint#maxSearchTime} and {@link Hpo.ExecutionConstraint#maxTrials}.
name: Hpo.Spec
